title: API keys
intro: Scripts and other programs use an API key to read, flag and send mail through the REST API. A key never reaches settings, rules or sign-in.
loadFailed: This page could not be loaded. Reload the page to try again.
emptyDescription: Create a key for each program that should reach your mail, with only the access it needs.
label: Name
labelDescription: Say which program uses the key, for example Backup script.
scopesRequired: Choose at least one kind of access.

scopeDescription.read: List, search and download messages and list your addresses.
scopeDescription.write: Mark as read, star, archive and move to Trash.
scopeDescription.send: Send mail from your addresses, without attachments.

createdNotice: Copy the key now and store it with the program that uses it. If you lose it, revoke it and create a new one.
revokeDescription: Programs that use this key stop working at once. This can't be undone.
